note: globalRules: utm_* parameters are removed, unknown parameters are kept
globalRules: fbclid; when every parameter is removed the ? is dropped too
globalRules: gclid
globalRules: referralMarketing (ref) is removed by default, plus msclkid
nothing to remove: the URL is returned unchanged
surrounding whitespace is trimmed
no scheme: https:// is added, then the URL is cleaned
no scheme and nothing to remove: the output is still the normalized URL (changed stays false)
protocol-relative input (//host/path, e.g. copied from HTML) gets https: prepended, then is cleaned
protocol-relative input without a path
a host and port is not a scheme, so https:// is added
a space before ? is percent-encoded, so removing the query can't leave trailing whitespace
a space before # is percent-encoded, so removing the fragment can't leave trailing whitespace
a space inside the query is percent-encoded and its parameter kept
a space in the path is percent-encoded, as browsers do
Unicode whitespace (U+00A0) is percent-encoded using its UTF-8 bytes
non-http scheme: returned unchanged
non-http scheme: returned unchanged
repeated parameters: every matching occurrence is removed
valueless (flag) and empty-valued (q=) parameters are kept as they are
an empty piece (&&) is kept as it is
a valueless parameter is removed when a rule matches its name
trailing & is kept when nothing is removed
encoded parameter name: utm%5Fsource is tested as utm_source
remaining parameters keep their original encoding (%C3%A9, +, %2F)
a name with malformed percent-encoding is tested as written, and doesn't match
a fragment without = is not treated as parameters and is left as it is
a fragment route without = is left as it is
a fragment with = is treated as parameters
when every fragment parameter is removed the # is dropped too
text fragment: the value containing = is kept whole and nothing is rebuilt
text fragment next to a tracking parameter: only the tracker is removed
rules are case-insensitive; uppercase scheme, host and path are kept
amazon: tag (referralMarketing) and th (rules) are removed, psc is kept
amazon raw rule removes /ref=sr_1_1 from the path, then crid, keywords, qid and sr are removed
amazon country domain: raw rule and pd_rd_* / pf_rd_* parameters
upstream amazon raw rule /ref=[^/?]* also removes a following fragment (upstream behavior, kept as is)
uppercase host still matches the amazon provider and is kept uppercase
per-provider exceptions: amazon is skipped for /s? pages, but amazon search (crid) and globalRules (utm_source) still apply
per-provider exceptions: google is skipped for Gmail (ved kept), globalRules still removes utm_source
per-provider exceptions: globalRules is skipped for github.com (utm_source kept), the github.com provider still removes email_token
google search page: ei, ved, oq, gs_lcrp, sourceid and ie are removed, q is kept
google redirect: the q target is decoded once, unwrapped, then cleaned
google redirect with an encoded target in url=
double-encoded redirect target: decoded just enough rounds for https:// to appear
google AMP: the target has no scheme, so https:// is added
google AMP target is cleaned after unwrapping
facebook redirect: u is decoded, unwrapped, then fbclid is removed
facebook redirect from the lm. subdomain
double-wrapped: google redirect to a facebook redirect, both unwrapped, then cleaned
facebook page parameters: __tn__, eid and ref
